value.rationale: The ternary span-four radius-one case is a natural perfect-Hamming-code benchmark: ordinary q=3,n=4,R=1 covering can achieve the sphere-volume minimum of nine codewords, but the requirement that all centres be cyclic windows forces twelve. The 33% cyclic penalty is sharp, and the classification proves there is just one optimal class under relabeling, rotation and reversal. This resolves the first nonbinary Hamming-perfect small-span instance in the single-cycle setting, sharpening structural understanding beyond an isolated codeword example.
